names_assigned_data_frame.r_text: d <- data.frame(p = 1:2, q = 3:4); names(d) <- c('u', 'v'); d

stopifnot_false.error: c(TRUE, FALSE) are not all TRUE

assign_superassign.r_text: x <- 1; f <- function() { x <<- 5 }; f(); x

operator_logic.r_text: c(TRUE, FALSE) & c(TRUE, TRUE) | c(FALSE, FALSE)

for_loop.r_text: s <- 0; for (i in 1:4) s <- s + i; s

function_no_defaults.r_text: f <- function(a, b) a + b; f(1, 2)

function_with_defaults.r_text: f <- function(a, b = 10) a + b; f(1)

function_named_call.r_text: f <- function(a, b = 10) a - b; f(b = 1, a = 5)

function_closure.r_text: make <- function(k) function(x) x * k; make(3)(4)

function_lazy_default.r_text: f <- function(a, b = a * 2) b; f(4)

call_nse_column.r_text: res <- rma(yi, vi, data = escalc(measure = 'RR', ai = tpos, bi = tneg, ci = cpos, di = cneg, data = dat.bcg)); round(res$beta, 4)

call_formula_model.r_text: res <- rma(yi ~ ablat, vi, data = escalc(measure = 'RR', ai = tpos, bi = tneg, ci = cpos, di = cneg, data = dat.bcg)); round(coef(res), 4)
